postgresanalytics.description: Bundled PostgreSQL 18 advanced analytics container for data science desktops (`scidesktop`, `aidesktop`) loaded via `ml` (Lmod / Apptainer). ### Bundled Extensions - **Geospatial**: `postgis`, `postgis_topology`, `postgis_raster` (plus `shp2pgsql` and `raster2pgsql`) - **Vector & AI Embeddings**: `vector` (`pgvector`) and `pgedge_vectorizer` (`v1.1`) - **Horizontal Partitioning**: `plproxy` - **Time-Series & Streaming Analytics**: `timescaledb` (Apache-2.0 edition), `hll` (HyperLogLog), `tdigest` - **Query Optimization & Contrib**: `hypopg`, `pg_stat_statements`, `btree_gin`, `btree_gist`, `pg_trgm`, `hstore`, `uuid-ossp`, `citext`, `cube`, `earthdistance`, `tablefunc` ### Quick Start (Read-Only Apptainer / Non-Root Desktops) The `pg-analytics` helper runs PostgreSQL in user space on port `5433` by default (avoiding port `5432` used by Airflow/MLflow in `aidesktop`):
